question: Does retraining E61's anchor 1 run a1_1e-6, changing only the saves, give the same run, with fp32 δW the D1 and D3 readings can use?

first_minutes.source: predictions_train.json .first_minutes['a1_1e-6'] of experiments/qwen_recipe/results, copied unchanged; form and sources there. E61's run read: step 1 loss 0.97258, |dW| 0; step 2 loss 1.10593, |dW| 0.00336; step 10 loss 0.34897. Step 2's peak may read up to about 31.4 GiB rather than 30.45, because E78 also reads at step 1.

reproduction.rule: Step 100 of train.json against E61's values (train_a1_1e-6.json .steps[99]), each |x - e61| <= rel_tol x e61; a missing or non-finite value misses. Reported, no stop: T has already finished. Any miss: 'did not reproduce', told to the lead before the files are used.
reproduction.source: No repeat of a 100-step fp32 run exists. Nearest measured: E61 arm 0 and its repeat (fp32, same L40 recipe, 4 steps), gaps up to about 1e-6 on loss, |dW| and held; E40 and its regeneration (100 steps, bf16 autocast, 1e-5, H100 against L40), gaps 0.066% on |dW|, up to 0.12% on loss at the read steps, 0.63% on maths KL. 1% is above all of these and is chosen to also fail a wrong state: E61's own step 50 misses step 100 on every number (|dW| 4.9%, loss 21%, held 14%, KL 2.9%). The run's step_gaps in read.json gives this recipe's own floor for later use.
reproduction.blind_to: Whether the two runs' δW agree in direction (the cosine in files does that); differences under 1% that a later reading may be sensitive to.

files.rule: Each of the 8 files (steps 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100): the header has `tensors` tensors, all `dtype`; the fp64 norm over the file within norm_rel of the same step's training |dW| (train.json). Then step 100 against E61's bf16 step 100: 1 - cos <= one_minus_cos_max and |E61| / |E78| in norm_ratio. Any miss stops before generation (exit 1).
files.norm_rel_source: Measured on E69's R at step 100: file 0.35088369255, training record 0.35088369164, gap 2.6e-9; 1e-6 is a margin of about 400.
files.cos_sources: Measured on the CPU 2026-11-03 (scratch floors.py). Rounding alone, E69's fp32 R step 100 against itself cast to bf16: 1 - cos 1.39e-6, norm ratio 0.9999984; rounding_alone_max is a margin of about 3.6 and only labels the reading: at or under it the two runs agree to rounding, above it a run difference is also there. Wrong state, E61's step 50 against its step 100: 1 - cos 0.0148, norm ratio 1.051, so the band's stop is 15 times under it. The difference between two runs of the recipe is not measured; 1e-3 allows a 4.5% residual, against 1% for |dW|.
files.blind_to: Any error common to E61's and E78's runs; the cosine is taken over all 196 matrices, so a small matrix could differ and not show. A file's norm cannot tell it from a sign flip or a permuted matrix; the cosine can for step 100 only.

rule.statement: E61's rules.template at step 100: format_unprompted >= rate_min and strict_dropped >= strict_min, on GSM8K test 0-255, generated from W0 plus the saved step 100.
rule.sources: predictions_train.json .rules.template; strict_min is E61's lines.json, its prompted W0 reading 0.6403 less 0.08. Not read again here: same model, problems and generation.
rule.blind_to: Whether the template carries over beyond test 0-255; E61's reading sits 0.06 above its accuracy line, 2 se at 256 problems, so a small run difference could cross it.

edge_cases.step 1 file: All zeros by the schedule. Record 0, norm_rel x 0 = 0: only an exactly zero file passes. Its cosine is never taken.
edge_cases.a file missing: No header, 0 tensors: the row misses, no read attempted, the job stops.
edge_cases.a zero step 100: No cosine (NaN): at_most fails, stop. Also misses its row first.
edge_cases.a BF16 file: dtype set is not {F32}: the row misses, the mistake this check exists for.
edge_cases.rate 0, as at W0: format_unprompted 0: fails. Expected at W0 (`P.json .format.without`), the rule's built-in negative.
edge_cases.ties at a threshold: at_least and at_most round to 9 decimals and include the bound.

not_read_here: Steps other than 100 are not generated. The step-20 reading E61 made is not repeated. No anchor 2 data.
